title: Valid Anagram
summary: Imagine taking the letters of the first string apart and rearranging them.

contractDetails.constraints: Each string has 1–50,000 lowercase English letters.

statement: Imagine taking the letters of the first string apart and rearranging them. Return whether those exact letters can form the second string, with every occurrence used once.

examples.explanation: Both strings have two o's, one l and one p.
Only the second string has an x.
The strings use the same letters but disagree on their counts.

constraints: Each string has 1–50,000 lowercase English letters.
hints: Conceptual: Reordering leaves the number of copies of every letter unchanged.
Directional: Use 26 counters, one per letter.
Implementation: Add to the counters for the first string and subtract for the second. Check that all counters end at zero.
complexityAnalysis: O(|s| + |t|) time and O(1) auxiliary space. The alphabet size fixes the number of counters.
